Welcome in

A gym that feels like part of the neighbourhood

No pressure, no posing — just a warm, welcoming space where people from around Rumuodomaya come to get stronger, fitter and healthier together. Whether it's your first week in a gym or you're training for something specific, there's a way in for you here.

Train on your own with the strength machines and cardio kit, join the energy of a group class, learn to box, bring the kids to their own fitness sessions, or sit down for nutrition consulting to support your training.

  • 🏋️ Strength, cardio & functional training areas
  • 🥊 Boxing, martial arts & kickboxing coaching
  • 🧒 Dedicated kids' fitness — active, safe and fun
Classes & Training

Train your way — solo, in a class, or with a coach

Everything on offer at Neighbourhood Gym, in one place. Use the filters to find your thing, then enquire or pop in to ask about the current class schedule.

Strength

Strength Machines

Build strength at your own pace on the machines and free weights. A solid starting point if you're new, and the backbone of any training routine.

Ask about strength training →
Cardio

Cardio

Get your heart pumping and build stamina with cardio training. Warm up before a session, or make it the main event — your call.

Ask about cardio →
CrossFit

CrossFit

Varied, high-energy workouts that mix lifting, cardio and bodyweight movements — scaled to your level and coached in a group setting.

Ask about CrossFit →
Functional

Functional Training

Full-body training built around movements you use every day — lifting, pushing, pulling and carrying — to build strength that carries over to real life.

Ask about functional training →
Combat

Boxing & Martial Arts

Learn technique, footwork and discipline while getting seriously fit. Boxing and martial arts training for fitness, confidence and skill.

Ask about boxing →
Combat

Kickboxing

High-energy kickboxing that combines punches, kicks and conditioning. A powerful full-body workout that never gets boring.

Ask about kickboxing →
Dance fitness

Aerobics & Zumba

Music up, worries down. Aerobics and Zumba sessions that feel more like a party than a workout — and burn energy like one too.

Ask about aerobics & Zumba →
Kids

Kids' Fitness

Active, supervised fitness sessions designed for children — movement, games and exercises that build healthy habits early and keep them smiling.

Ask about kids' fitness →
Wellness

Nutrition Consulting

Training works better with the right fuel. Get nutrition guidance to sit alongside your workouts and support your goals.

Getting started

Your first visit, step by step

1

Pop in

Find us at No. 2 Alhaji Estate Road, Rumuodomaya — opposite Obio/Akpor Council, near Water Gate Hotel.

2

Look around

See the strength, cardio and functional areas, and get a feel for the classes on offer.

3

Enquire

Ask the team about membership and the class schedule, or send the enquiry form below.

4

Get moving

Pick your first session — a class, the machines, or a bit of both — and you're underway.

Membership, without the guesswork

Membership options and current prices are confirmed directly with the gym, so you always get the up-to-date picture. Send a quick enquiry and the team can walk you through what suits you — training on your own, classes, kids' fitness, or a mix.

Enquire for membership

Good things to ask about

  • Current membership options & prices
  • Which classes are included
  • Kids' fitness for your children
  • Nutrition consulting add-ons
  • The current class timetable
Our coaches

Friendly faces to guide your training

You're not left to figure it all out alone. The coaching team at Neighbourhood Gym covers the full range of training on offer — here's who looks after what.

🏋️

Strength & Conditioning Coaches

Help with the machines, free weights and functional training — technique first, so you build strength safely.

🥊

Boxing & Martial Arts Coaches

Lead boxing, martial arts and kickboxing training, from first stance and footwork to bag and pad work.

🎵

Aerobics & Zumba Instructors

Bring the music and the energy to group dance-fitness sessions that keep the whole room moving.

🧒

Kids' Fitness Coaches

Run active, supervised sessions for children, built around movement, games and healthy habits.

🥗

Nutrition Support

Practical nutrition consulting to help your eating support your training and everyday energy.

🤝

Here to Help

New to the gym? Any member of the team can point you to the right area, class or coach — just ask.
